Sub: Grant of exemption from the provisions of EDLI Scheme, 1976 under Section 17(2A)
of the EPF & MP Act, 1952

Sir

, .

As you are aware that Provisions have been made to grant relaxation/exemption to
establishment in respect of EDLI under the provisions of Section 17(2A) of the EPF & MP Act.
Accordingly, numbers of establishments are being granted relaxation/exemption under the
provisions. It has been observed that the relaxation/exemption granted are not renewed
periodically and many of the recommendation forwarded to headquarters contain proposals for
renewal of exemption under EDLI with retrospective effect ranging from 1 to 4 spells. All offices
are advised to put in place appropriate monitoring system to ensure such relaxation/exemption
are reviewed periodically and steps are taken to renew in time.
